title: Promotion / announcement / launch — text-heavy graphic video
summary: A short announcement where the graphics are the message: the offer in the first second, the product or place shown, the terms clear, the deadline real, one CTA. Footage stays visible behind big type; every number matches the listing.

runtime.why: An offer is understood in seconds; repetition beats length.

hook.purpose: the offer itself (the number) on the product

structure.purpose: what is on offer, hero shots
the terms: price, discount, dates, conditions

structure.graphics: cart (TikTok Shop) or pin (store), stat (days left, only if real)

music.mood: bright, punchy; hits under the price reveals

compliance: Every price, discount and date matches the listing or the store's terms
No false scarcity or countdown that is not real
Conditions of the offer stated (minimum order, while stock lasts, dates)
Logos and artwork are the advertiser's own or licensed
